CustomField.description: When real-time (Instantly and Both) totals are recalculated: Background (queued in the save and recalculated just after it, the default) or In_Save (recalculated in the save when it is small enough). Blank means Background. Custom settings cannot hold a picklist, so the allowed values are declared on the Rollup_Processing setting definition and validated by the settings service.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: After the save (recommended) keeps saves fast; During the save updates totals before the page refreshes.
CustomField.label: Rollup Processing
